sentences.text: The teacher asked us to stand.
Standing a long time tires you.

Falling from a tree is dangerous.
The child wanted to hold my hand.

Rubbing skin should be done gently.
He began to pull the rope.
They began to push the car.
I learned to throw a ball.
I learned to tie a rope.
Sewing with a needle is easy.

sentences.text: Counting from one to ten is easy.
Children love playing in the yard.

The sun rises in the morning.
We brought water from the well.
After the rain ended the grass grew.
The family went to the lake.
A ship travels on the sea.
There is salt in the food.
The child picked up a stone.
The house was built from stone.
There is sand on the beach.
There is dust on the window.
A seed was planted in the earth.
Wind is felt on the porch.
There is ice on the glass.
